scenes.title: The late train
opening: The platform clock says 21:30. The train is late, and nobody has pretended to read for ten minutes.
Alice holds your ticket like a bookmark, thumb pressed to the corner. Emily stands three steps off, watching the tracks instead of you.
choices: Alice — I'm staying. The train being late isn't the reason.
Emily, there's something you should hear from me, not from anyone else.
Let's not do this on a platform. Give me one minute.

cues.proposition: The user told Emily they are staying in the city.

fallback_lines.alice: Say it again. I'd like to hear it without the train noise.
fallback_lines.emily: I'm listening. Don't dress it up.
fallback_lines.sophia: You said 'staying' like it was a question.
fallback_lines.mia: There are fries in my bag. Nobody decides anything until those are gone.

scenes.title: Last call
opening: Last call. The announcement repeats itself, patient in a way none of you are.
Alice looks at Emily, then at you, and folds whatever she meant to say back into her sleeve.
choices: Alice, say it. Whatever it is, say it now.
Emily, I should have told you sooner. I know that.
We can miss this train. It isn't the last one.

cues.proposition: Alice heard the user choose to stay.

fallback_lines.alice: I heard you the first time. I'm still here.
fallback_lines.emily: Then say it to me. Not to the platform.
fallback_lines.sophia: The doors are closing. You have about six seconds to mean it.
fallback_lines.mia: There's another train in the morning. I'll bring breakfast.
